name: Smite the Wicked
text: Revelation - Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded. Attach Smite the Wicked to that enemy and spawn it at the location farthest from you. Forced - When the game ends, if attached enemy is in play: Zoey Samaras suffers 1 mental trauma.
text_cn: 顯現 - 從遭遇牌堆頂棄牌，直到棄掉1張敵人，將其生成在離你最遠的地點上，並將擊退邪惡疊加到該敵人卡。 強制 - 在遊戲結束時，如果被疊加的敵人在場：佐伊·薩馬拉斯受到1點精神創傷。(FAQ, v1.0)
